sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 6XL+.
Performs a critical hit.
Target: yourself. Recovers 10 Cost.
Restores 5% of damage dealt as HP.
Target: yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 5.
Ability Power scales with the number of Star elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of 7XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
L+
Activation rate scales with the number of Star elemental Weapons equipped up to a max of XXL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 3).
